name: ARCOOKIE Viewer
summary:
ARCOOKIE Viewer is a free Meta Quest app for experiencing AR art exhibitions and immersive 3D content.

With ARCOOKIE Viewer, users can explore selected AR artworks and 3D scenes prepared through the ARCOOKIE platform. After launching the app, users can move through the space and approach visual nodes to load and view AR art content in an immersive environment.
